definitions.full: H3638. Kilmad כִּלְמַד proper name, of a location (si vera lectio) Ezek 27:23 , named after ᵐ5 אַשּׁוּר, Ξαρμαν ; = modern Kalwâdha near Bagdad, according to G. Smith TSBA i, 61 Dl Pa 206 , compare Schr COT ; but text dubious see Co; ומדי ᵑ7 , whence Mez Stadt Harran 34 כָּלמָֿדַי all Media ; JKi Hi Co כְּלִמּוּד ( רְכֻלָּתֵךְ ) Asshur was as thine apprentice (see below למד ) in trading ; but sense not very probably
